run_mmf_job_with_opts: run an MMF training job programmatically by passing opts like training.batch_size=64
run_mmf_inference: run an MMF model in prediction mode by setting predict=True in the run function
run_mmf_distributed: run an MMF job across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn
run_mmf_from_cli: run an MMF job from the command line using the flags parser and run entry point
run_mmf_on_tpu: run an MMF distributed job on TPU cores using torch_xla multiprocessing spawn
